ICS 07.100.30FAD 31New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian standard is identical with ISO 16649-3 : 2015 ‘Microbiology of the food chain - Horizontal method for the enumeration of beta glucuronidase positive Escherichia coli - Part 3: Detection and most probable number technique using 5-bromo-4-chloro-3-indolyl-ß-D-glucuronide’ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Microbiology Sectional Committee and approval of the Food and Agriculture Division Council.This Indian Standard is published in three parts which are identical adoptions of their corresponding ISO standards. The other parts in this series are:Part 1 Colony-count technique at 44 °C using membranes and 5-bromo-4-chloro-3-indolylbeta-D-glucuronidePart 2 Colony-count technique at 44 °C using 5-bromo-4-chloro-3-indolyl ß-D-glucuronide
